### Risk 2: The TYPE4/5 collapse semantics. Let me re-read the exact protocol words once more:

"A subtree with one or two owned prefixes uses TYPE4 or TYPE5 respectively. Larger subtrees use TYPE1 with 0..2 children, TYPE2 with 3..6, or TYPE3 with 7..64. Roots may occupy any of the 11 stages; stage 0 is the tail, 10 the head. Every child stage is STRICTLY LOWER than its parent."

✓ consistent with my implementation.

And the inline prefix rule ✓.
